query:
SELECT ca.status, COUNT(*) as total, ROUND(SUM(ar.valorLiquido), 2) as valor
FROM accounts_receivable ar
LEFT JOIN collection_actions ca ON ca.accounts_receivable_id = ar.id
WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData < CURDATE()
AND ar.tipo IN ('TITULO', 'RECEITA', 'ADIANTAMENTO')
GROUP BY ca.status
ORDER BY total DESC;
